evals.prompt: Our onboarding email test showed almost no lift. Here are the assignments, send log, outcomes and our contact policy: examples/practica/experiment-broken/. Where did it go wrong?
evals.expected_output: Runs audit_sends.py; reports reach below the 90% gate (outage window), most sends going to users already ACTIVE (success state), cap violations (more than 3 sends), sends inside 24 hours, stale renders, and control users contacted; recommends no-send success state, send-time enforcement, re-render at send, and fixing delivery before rerunning.
assertions: Reports that a large share (40% or more) of sends went to users already in the success state
Reports cap violations and sub-24-hour spacing violations
Reports that control users received messages
Recommends enforcing caps and spacing at send time
Does not blame the copy as the main cause

evals.prompt: Write the contact policy and send-time checklist for a state-routed onboarding program using examples/practica/states/states.toml. Max 3 emails, at least a day apart.
evals.expected_output: Produces contact-policy.toml (cap 3, spacing 24h, SLA, reach gate, success and no-send states) and a send-time checklist covering arm, state match, no-send, cap, spacing, window, suppression, converted, valid address, unsubscribe, approved template, personalisation, kill switch; defines termination reasons.
assertions: ACTIVE is listed as success and no-send
The checklist re-checks state immediately before sending
Termination reasons are defined before launch

evals.prompt: How do I build this state-routed onboarding in Braze without duplicating our state logic in segment filters?
evals.expected_output: Recommends computing state outside Braze and syncing one attribute, triggering on state change, exit criteria on success or conversion, frequency caps verified against delivery data, a control group, and rendering facts at send via Liquid.
assertions: Recommends computing the state outside the platform as a single attribute
Mentions exit criteria on success or conversion
Mentions verifying caps against delivery or send logs
